newsitem.title: USA: ADR REPORT - Italy's ENI eases.
newsitem.headline: ADR REPORT - Italy's ENI eases.

text.p: Italy's state-controlled energy group Ente Nazionale Idrocarburi SpA, or ENI, eased Monday to stand out in quiet trade.
A trader said markets were featureless as investors switched to "pre-holiday mode" ahead of the three-day U.S. Independence Day weekend.
"People are getting ready for the big barbecue," he said. Traders said ADRs were weighed by some profit taking and squaring of accounts at the end of the second quarter.

ENI was off 11/16 to 56-5/8 after completion of the third tranche of its public offering Friday. Its volume in mid-morning was 464,100 ADRs traded, putting the company among the most active ADRs on the New York Stock Exchange.
Among other active ADRs, Royal Dutch Petroleum Co was off 1/2 to 52-7/8 after its shares split four to one. London-based Senetek Plc fell 9/32 to 4-7/16.
Among Latin American ADRs, Brazilian telephone holding Telebras SA was off 2-13/16 to 151-9/16 after Credit Suisse First Boston and HSBC James Capel cut their ratings on shares.
HSBC James Capel analyst Paul Aran cut his rating to long-term buy from buy, saying Telebras had reached his price target.
Decliners led advancers 262 to 164 among 814 ADRs. The ADR group was off 0.30 percent in late morning and volume was 19.7 million shares.
